Who Can Join as a Vendor?

MarryMate welcomes both registered businesses and independent service providers who offer wedding-related services in Sri Lanka. Our platform is designed to help vendors connect with couples, promote their services, and manage booking opportunities through one centralized system.

Vendors such as wedding halls, catering services, photography and videography teams, bridal dressing and salons, entertainment providers, cake designers, invitation designers, and honeymoon package providers can register and become part of the MarryMate platform.

  • Wedding Venues / Halls
  • Photography & Videography
  • Catering Services
  • Bridal Dressing & Salons
  • Entertainment Services
  • Wedding Cake Designers
  • Invitation Designers / Printers
  • Honeymoon Package Providers

Register as a Vendor

Choose the registration type that matches your service model

Company / Business

Register as a company vendor if you operate as a wedding hall, studio, catering service, salon, event company, or any other organized business providing wedding services.

  • Company-based service profile
  • Business contact details
  • Category and district listing
  • Service description and pricing

Individual / Freelancer

Register as an individual vendor if you provide wedding services independently, such as photography, bridal dressing, cake design, entertainment, invitation design, or other freelance services.

  • Personal service profile
  • Service and contact details
  • Category-based visibility
  • Easy registration process
